description: This file defines the RepaymentPeriod class, which models a repayment period in a loan repayment schedule, including details such as interest periods, amounts, dates, and calculated financial metrics.

classes.name: RepaymentPeriod
classes.description: RepaymentPeriod models a segment of loan repayment, handling interest periods, payments, outstanding balances, and related calculations. It supports creating, copying, and managing repayment data within a schedule.

methods.name: getPrevious
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the previous repayment period, if any.

methods.name: getRateFactorPlus1
methods.description: Calculates the sum of rate factors plus one across interest periods.

methods.name: calculateRateFactorPlus1
methods.description: Internal method to compute the rate factor plus one by summing interest period rate factors.

methods.name: getCalculatedDueInterest
methods.description: Returns the total due interest, considering unrecognized interest and previous periods.

methods.name: calculateCalculatedDueInterest
methods.description: Computes the total due interest, incorporating interest period calculations and unrecognized interest.
